Owner completes Client A's annual module (last 2025-10-20); no phishing or general security training
gap: No training beyond the Client A module
remediation: Client A module plus a general security course with phishing (POL-01 9.6)

The suite records sign-ins and file activity, but nobody reviewed them until this assessment

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Not applicable: no internal workforce. Any future hire or standby engineer is briefed and signs an access agreement before access (POL-01 6.3)
Client notices given on time but ad hoc (Client A 2026-07-22; Client B 2026-07-23); P08 contacts not yet printed
gap: No written notice procedure until P08

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Objectives set in POL-01, the client terms, and the BIA (P05)
Risk assessment completed 2026-07-24 with SP 800-30, counting harm to clients
Payment redirection fraud (changed bank details on invoices) is assessed as P01 R-008
Change triggers set in POL-01 4.3. Before that, the AI trial and the drafter share started with no review
remediation: Apply POL-01 4.3 at the field laptop rollout (first significant change)

control_description: Annual self-assessment (P07); limited independence
remediation: Outside review at least every second year (POL-01 4.5)

control_description: Owner's direct oversight: deficiencies tracked in the POA&M and, where they touch a client, reported to that client

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected from the risk assessment and the client terms (P02 control set)
Technology controls partly in place: disk encryption and antivirus yes; least privilege and strong MFA no
gap: Administrator account; SMS codes; no MFA on accounting

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: POL-01 adopted 2026-08-31; the P08 runbook is the main procedure

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: Suite on SMS codes; passwords saved in the browser and reused; daily administrator account
Accounts are the owner's own; the drafter was given a folder share without Client A's authorization
gap: No written approval step before access
remediation: Client approval and access agreement first (POL-01 6.3)

control_description: Client folders owner-only since 2026-07-23; no routine share review yet
Home office locked; paper in a closed cabinet and shredded; client control houses entered only under client escort
Paper shredded. Two Client A projects from 2025 never certified as returned or destroyed; no device or USB wipe procedure

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: Host firewall on; home Wi-Fi shared with household devices; default router admin password
gap: Shared network on the path to the Client B gateway
remediation: Hotspot for gateway sessions now; separate business network

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: Client A BCSI copies in email; site photos synced to a personal cloud; Client C data in an AI SaaS; an open share link on a Client B folder (closed 2026-07-23)
remediation: Delete copies; photo sync off; AI deletion request; owner-only folders

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: Built-in antivirus detected and quarantined the test file; USB drives used for both personal and client files

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: Automatic OS updates; settings software updated by hand and two versions behind; no vendor advisory watch

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: No review of sign-ins or file activity
Events were evaluated ad hoc (drafter share, link share); evaluation steps now in P08
P08 runbook adopted 2026-08-31; not tested
Suite version history (30 days) inherited; local settings databases and license files have no backup
remediation: Daily backup and quarterly restore test (POL-01 8.10; P01 R-011)

control_description: Not applicable: the business develops no software and runs no infrastructure. Relay settings it delivers are reviewed, tested, and loaded by each client under the client's own change control. The owner's own setting changes are recorded in the security log
Single-person dependency: no standby engineer; recovery codes not stored
gap: Owner is a single point of failure
remediation: Standby engineer and sealed recovery codes (P01 R-010)

control_description: Email suite provider SOC 2 reviewed 2026-07-23; no vendor list; no drafter access agreement; AI SaaS and photo cloud never reviewed

remediation: Vendor list (POL-01 6.2); drafter agreement; AI tools stopped (P10)
